name: Implement a non-mutating deep merge
instruction: Implement deepMerge(a, b) in merge.js. Recursively merge plain objects: keys present in both whose values are plain objects are merged recursively; for any other type b's value wins; arrays are replaced (not concatenated). The function must NOT mutate either input. Return a new object. Keep the CommonJS export shape.
verifyCmd: node -e "const m=require('./merge.js'); const a={x:1,n:{p:1,q:2},arr:[1,2]}; const b={y:2,n:{q:9,r:3},arr:[9]}; const r=m(a,b); const eq=(x,y)=>JSON.stringify(x)===JSON.stringify(y); if(!eq(r,{x:1,n:{p:1,q:9,r:3},arr:[9],y:2})){console.error('merged=',JSON.stringify(r));process.exit(1)} if(a.n.q!==2||JSON.stringify(a.arr)!=='[1,2]'){console.error('mutated a');process.exit(1)} console.log('ok')"
